title: ARCADE: PLAYER 2 BACK FROM A RAID JOINS
why: From the review of the arcade core. If player 2 was still in a normal co-op raid when player 1 picked the arcade, player 2 said busy and was never asked again, so it could not join the arcade without a reload. Worse, when player 1 then dropped into an arcade raid, the player 2 window back in the Undercroft tried to build that raid as a normal one and only stopped because the two surfaces did not match, with a went up without you message. Now a window outside the arcade never takes an arcade raid; the player 2 window takes it as the invitation instead and shows PLAYER 2: PRESS A. Player 1 also asks a busy player 2 again every 3 seconds until it says it is in, and an invitation that comes twice never undoes a press of A. Normal co-op is exactly as it was.
now: Player 2 coming back from a normal raid is asked into the arcade again and joins with A.
